game-sqli-puzzle.intro: Craft the payload. Quotes and spacing are normalised when checked.

challenges.q: Query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE user='INPUT' AND pass='x'. Bypass the login. Give the value for INPUT.
challenges.hint: Close the string, make the condition true, comment the rest.

challenges.q: The query returns 3 columns. Give the fragment that tests for 4 columns and should error.
Query returns 3 columns and renders the 2nd. Extract the MySQL version into the rendered column.
challenges.hint: The version function goes in position two

challenges.q: Query returns 2 columns. List table names from the current database.
answers: ' union select 1,group_concat(table_name) from information_schema.tables where table_schema=database()-- -

challenges.q: Blind boolean injection with no output. Give the test that makes the condition always true.
Time-based blind on MySQL. Give the payload that delays five seconds.
Microsoft SQL Server with sysadmin. Give the payload to run a Windows command.
challenges.hint: The SQL Server command shell procedure

challenges.q: MySQL. Write a PHP webshell into the web root using the query result.

game-xss-builder.intro: Your payload must execute script. Give the exact string you would send.

challenges.q: Input lands directly in the HTML body, unescaped. Payload that alerts?
Input lands in a double-quoted attribute. Tags are filtered. Payload?
challenges.hint: Close the quote and add an event handler

challenges.q: Input lands in a single-quoted attribute. Payload?
Input lands inside a JS string with single quotes filtered out. Payload?
challenges.hint: Break out of the script block

challenges.q: Tags stripped, input lands in an href attribute. Give a URL that executes JS on click.
Steal document.cookie and send it to your listener.
challenges.hint: Exfiltrate with an image or fetch

challenges.q: Angle brackets are blocked but you are in an attribute context. Give a payload with no tags that still executes.
challenges.hint: Event handlers need no angle brackets

challenges.q: Give a payload that works in both attribute and body context.
challenges.hint: Close the attribute then add a tag

game-traversal-hunt.intro: Reach the file through the filter. Encodings welcome.

challenges.q: page=about loads from /var/www/html/pages/. No filtering. Payload for /etc/passwd?
The filter removes dot dot slash once, non-recursively. Payload?
challenges.hint: Nest so removal creates the sequence

challenges.q: Filter strips traversal but decodes after filtering. Payload?
Double encoding is required. Payload?
The app appends .php to your input. How do you still get /etc/passwd on a legacy runtime?
Windows target, from pages/. Payload for C:\Windows\win.ini?
challenges.hint: Windows uses backslashes, and they encode too

challenges.q: Path checks block traversal entirely. Use a PHP stream wrapper to read index.php base64-encoded.
You cannot read /etc/passwd. Give another Linux file that always exists and is world readable.

game-ssrf-filter.intro: Get past the blocklist and reach the target. Give the URL or host you would supply.

challenges.q: The filter blocks the literal string 127.0.0.1. Reach the local service on port 80 another way.
challenges.hint: Other representations of the same address

challenges.q: The filter blocks localhost and 127.0.0.1. Give an IPv6 form that reaches loopback.
Reach the cloud metadata service. Give the full URL.
On AWS with IMDSv2 the metadata service needs a token. Give the header-based step: what must you obtain first?
The filter only allows URLs starting with https://yourdomain.com. You control the DNS for yourdomain.com. What do you point it at?
The server follows redirects and validates the URL before fetching. What do you host?
answers: a redirect to the metadata service
challenges.hint: Validation before the redirect is worthless

challenges.q: The filter blocks 169.254.169.254. Give a decimal representation of that address.
challenges.hint: Convert the dotted quad to a single integer
